Chapter 694: Chapter 5: Lin Yuan’s One Strike (Additional Release, Seeking Monthly Votes at the Beginning of the Month)

Within the black door, there was a vast expanse of heaven and earth.

“Contained space within the ‘Jiezi’?” Lin Yuan was cautious and kept observing his surroundings.

The black sphere was not large, yet the space within the door was so vast; Lin Yuan did not find it strange.

It was just a deeper application of the Space Rules.

Lin Yuan’s inner world extended over two hundred million miles but was hidden within a fist-sized Qi Sea.

It was a similar principle.

...

“The suppression in this space is so strong,” Lin Yuan secretly exclaimed.

The massive suppression was far beyond that of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm; Lin Yuan was now unable to even blend into the Spatial Layers.

“Over there…”

Lin Yuan looked ahead, beneath his feet there was a path made of black pebbles. Aside from this path, everywhere else appeared white.

“It’s only safe to walk along the path of black pebbles,” Lin Yuan’s third eye twitched as he looked toward the white area, a sense of dread rising in his heart, yet the narrow path of black pebbles brought a sense of safety.

“Hmm?”

“Can’t go back?”

Lin Yuan turned to look.

He found that the door behind him had already disappeared.

Now, the only option for Lin Yuan was a single path.

That was to keep moving forward.

“So be it.”

“At most, I’ll just lose this Primordial Spirit.”

“It’s not unacceptable.”

After pondering for a while, Lin Yuan directly followed the path of black pebbles.

Regarding this black sphere, Lin Yuan had already informed the Goddess of Wisdom; the three goddesses surely knew by now.

If the three goddesses knew, then the Xia Qin Supreme Being and other ultimate existences must definitely be aware.

In such a situation, if the Xia Qin Supreme Being did not specifically inform him, it indicated that there might not be any significant danger associated with the black sphere.

The black sphere was related to the distant past event where countless treasures fell into the Cosmic Starry Sky, and human civilization had acquired the key treasure and its heritage from that event, so the Xia Qin Supreme Being must be quite knowledgeable about the black sphere.

The fact that the Xia Qin Supreme Being did not actively inform Lin Yuan signified that there were no irreparable dangers present.

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, half an hour went by.

“Hmm?”

“I feel other rule fluctuations rapidly becoming vague, and only the Life and Death Rules are starting to become clearer?” Lin Yuan noticed the changes around him.

“Life and Death Rules? Is this world related to the Life and Death Samsara Rule?”

Many speculations arose in Lin Yuan’s heart, but they were just that—speculations. To understand clearly, he had to continue onward.

…

Xia You Evolution Tower.

Xia Qin Supreme Being seemed to sense something, slightly lifting his head to look towards a certain area.

If Lin Yuan were present, he would have noticed that the Xia Qin Supreme Being’s gaze was directed at the Star Domain where the black sphere was located.

“That kid went in,” a smile appeared on Xia Qin Supreme Being’s face.

Hum.

A figure quickly condensed beside him, the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being.

“That Heritage Star probably originated from an oversight of the past. We’ve gone so many years without discovering it, yet that kid stumbled upon it so easily, he’s really lucky.”

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being smiled slightly.

The black sphere’s aura was completely concealed; even Supreme Beings couldn’t detect it unless they were within a certain proximity.

Otherwise, with the perception of Supreme Beings that can see through millions and tens of millions of light-years at a glance, searching the entire Cosmic Starry Sky would not take too long.

Divine treasures conceal themselves. Some treasures cannot be detected unless one is close by.

Even for certain kinds of treasures, if one does not meet the criteria, they might not detect any anomalies even when close.

Just like the Mysterious Gourd Lin Yuan possesses; if it weren’t for the Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Blood Rebirth’ that Lin Yuan happened to master, it’s likely he would still be clueless about the use of that gourd now.

“Inside the Heritage Star, there are paths of Pillar-level Fusion Rules that only Tenth Rank Life can enter. If that kid can get through three or four types, he might be able to step into Tier 11…” said the Xia Qin Supreme Being.

“Three or four types?” The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being pondered for a while.

Normally, a Tenth Rank Evolver only needs to get through one to step into Tier 11, but considering Lin Yuan’s previous outstanding feats, going through three or four types is not out of the question.

“I just don’t know how many realms of Fusion Rules the paths contained within that Heritage Star reach?” the Xia Qin Supreme Being muttered to himself.

According to the highest secrets owned by human civilization, Heritage Stars from outside the universe also vary in rank.

Depending on the maximum realms reached by the contained Fusion Rules paths, the higher the level, the more precious it is, but the harder it is to pass through as well.

Of course, to know the maximum realms, one must first traverse a path of the Fusion Rules.

Without doing so, even Supreme Beings cannot know its limits.

Supreme Beings have the means to destroy the black sphere, but such Heritage Stars will go into Self-Destruct mode if they sense an unstoppable threat.

…

Within the black door.

In the vast expanse of heaven and earth, Lin Yuan was walking step by step along the path made of black pebbles.

Not knowing how much time had passed.

Lin Yuan arrived in front of a black ritual altar.

“This place…”

Lin Yuan stopped in his tracks and began to sense carefully.

Here, he could no longer perceive fluctuations from other rules.

Only the Life and Death Rules became incredibly clear.

Not sensing rule fluctuations meant he could not borrow the power of the rules.

For example, the ‘Spatial Rupture’ Fusion Rules that Lin Yuan comprehended came from a fusion of the Space Rules and the Golden Rules.

But in this world, the efficacy of such Fusion Rules would be greatly weakened, because he could not feel the Space Rules or the Golden Rules at all.

He could only rely on the ‘Spatial Rupture’ Fusion Rules he had mastered.

“But now, where should I go?”

Lin Yuan looked over the altar before him.

After waiting cautiously for a while and noticing no changes, he stepped onto the altar.

The moment Lin Yuan set foot on the altar, the entire altar began to shake slightly.

Hum.

Massive amounts of black light rapidly converged, condensing into a black-robed man with an ancient demeanor.

“Who are you?”

Lin Yuan looked at the black-robed man, his expression growing slightly solemn.

“Greetings.”

“I am the Altar Spirit, and I shall now subject you to some trials.”

“Should you pass, you will obtain the ultimate reward for this path of Fusion Rules.”

The black-robed man’s tone was calm as he looked at Lin Yuan and said slowly.

“The Altar Spirit?”

Lin Yuan quickly understood the ‘position’ of the black-robed man.

Similar to the Stone Statue Shen Ji in the Demon Jade Space and the Six-Armed Silhouette in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

“May I ask, senior, what is the ultimate reward?” Lin Yuan immediately inquired.

“You’ll know once you go in,” the black-robed man shook his head. “Only those who pass the trial may know what the ultimate reward is. However, I can hint that the ultimate reward is related to the Life and Death Samsara Rule.”

“I see.”

Lin Yuan’s face showed realization, but inside he was rather speechless.

He naturally could speculate that the ultimate reward was related to the Life and Death Samsara Rule.

Could it be that behind this door, which one could only enter upon comprehending the Life and Death Samsara Rule, lay a reward related to the Great Destruction Rule?

“What is the trial?” Lin Yuan asked again.

“The trial tests your mastery of the Life and Death Samsara Rule,” the black-robed man stated succinctly.

“Presumably you have already felt that, in this world, only the fluctuations of life and death rules exist; no other rules can be perceived,” the black-robed man said.

“Correct.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

In short, the strongest rule that Lin Yuan could now wield was the Life and Death Samsara Rule.

“Now.”

The black-robed man gestured with a wave of his hand, and dozens of black stone walls descended, erecting themselves not far away.

The dozens of black stone walls stood in a row from front to back.

“The Life and Death Samsara Rule is a rule of slaughter, and testing such a rule is based on the level of destructiveness caused.”

“Now, operate the Life and Death Samsara Rule with all your strength and attack the black stone walls. The more walls you penetrate, the more hope you have of passing the trial,” the black-robed man said directly without mincing words.

“Operate with all my strength?”

Lin Yuan repeated.

“Yes.”

“Full strength.”

“Let me see the limit of your destructive power,” said the black-robed man, giving Lin Yuan an extra glance as if he wondered why Lin Yuan would ask such a question.

“Don’t worry. Seeing the aura of your Life and Death Samsara Rule, you must have just grasped it.”

“Under such circumstances, even if you stimulate the Life and Death Samsara Rule with all your might, the strength that erupts will barely penetrate the first black stone wall, not to mention completely pass through,” the black-robed man patiently explained.

Although he had predicted the scope of destruction Lin Yuan would cause by ultimately stimulating the Life and Death Samsara Rule,

It was just the scope. As for how much power, like how much of the first black stone wall would be penetrated, it still needed Lin Yuan’s own effort to verify.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Since comprehending the Life and Death Samsara Rule, he had never yet fully utilized this rule in action.

Even in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, he had stopped as soon as he realized the impact this Fusion Rule had on the realm, exercising restraint.

“Begin.”

After the black-robed man spoke, he became silent.

When Lin Yuan opened the outer door with a trace of Life and Death Samsara Rule’s power and entered, he made a rough estimate of the power of Life and Death Samsara Rule Lin Yuan had grasped.

“Life and Death Samsara…”

Lin Yuan raised his right hand and stretched out his index finger, solemnly touching each black stone wall that wasn’t far away with a gentle tap.

The black-robed man’s face was initially expressionless, but soon after, his expression changed dramatically. He looked at Lin Yuan’s gently extended finger in disbelief.

“What?”

The black-robed man’s pupils shrank sharply.

The next moment.

The power of Life and Death Samsara instantly pierced through billions of Spatial Layers, tearing open a hole. The black stone walls were crushed without a doubt, and that hole continued to spread swiftly towards the distance, piercing through the entire world in an instant and moving on to even deeper realms.

It wasn’t until a faint vibration echoed that everything settled down.

Even so, in the gray area that the hole had passed through, the power of Life and Death Samsara continued to operate ceaselessly. Everything was distorting, and everything was being annihilated.

…

Xia You Evolution Tower.

Xia Qin Supreme Being and Feather Butterfly were leisurely chatting while observing the black star.

At that moment.

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s complexion showed a strange change.

He then looked carefully at the black star many light-years away.

After a moment.

Xia Qin Supreme Being narrowed his eyes and spoke:

“Feather Butterfly,”

“Did you notice that the Heritage Star…”

“Seemed to tremble just now?”

…

…

…
